title: For N>=3, hbar*c=N*epsilon_2 and epsilon_2 nonzero, the type-A affine Yangian evaluation image contains every diagonal Heisenberg current via the explicit finite-correction preimages a_m
author: Ryosuke Kodera
source_title: Braid Group Action on Affine Yangian
difficulty_reason: A diagonal loop current cannot be recovered by simply applying the existing affine-sl evaluation map. The author constructs braid-translated degree-one commutators, tracks the affine central terms, and proves that their infinite completed quadratic corrections cancel to a finite element of the affine-sl enveloping subalgebra. The resulting explicit preimages for all positive, zero and negative modes establish a substantial quantum-algebra image theorem.
source_version: Official SIGMA 15 (2019) article 020, DOI 10.3842/SIGMA.2019.020; journal PDF and native TeX acquired 2026-09-30, exact bytes pinned by SHA256

proof_review.method: Published author proof/core and local context fidelity screening
proof_review.note: The complete construction proving Theorem4.18 was read: Section3.1 gives the braid automorphisms and relations; Section4.1 supplies their matrix-current action; Sections4.2–4.3 identify the evaluation map, construct the zero mode, compute braid-translated real-root currents and all quadratic terms, and cancel the completed infinite sums to a finite correction R_m in U(affine sl_N). The negative modes follow by the explicitly stated anti-automorphism omega. The established Guay evaluation homomorphism (Theorem4.7) is cited background. The new finite correction and image identities, not merely existence of the evaluation map, are the selected obligation. The author explicitly does not prove the preimages a_m themselves satisfy Heisenberg relations; no such embedding claim is selected.

statement_scope: Exactly Theorem4.18: N>=3; the complex type-A affine Yangian has parameters epsilon_1,epsilon_2 and hbar=epsilon_1+epsilon_2; the target affine-gl_N central element is specialized to the scalar c with hbar*c=N*epsilon_2 and epsilon_2!=0. For every integer m the explicitly displayed a_m, using the finite R_m of Proposition4.16, satisfies ev(a_m)=1(m); hence the image in the specified completed enveloping target contains the ordinary enveloping algebra of affine gl_N at this central specialization. This is an image/preimage assertion. It does not assert that the a_m satisfy Heisenberg commutation relations inside the affine Yangian, nor count the irreducibility corollary separately.
editorial_warning: The source calls the image currents Heisenberg generators, but Remark4.21 expressly leaves their preimage commutation relations open. The title and selected scope therefore claim explicit preimages and image containment only. The nonzero epsilon_2 and rank N>=3 hypotheses are retained.
source_boundary_note: The full original Theorem 4.18 and its complete preceding author derivation are retained. Affine-Yangian, braid and matrix-current conventions and the established Guay evaluation homomorphism are supplied, followed by the actual zero-mode construction, braid-translated real-root/current terms, quadratic cancellations, finite correction R_m and anti-automorphism passage to negative modes. Coproduct compatibility and later representation corollaries are not counted. No assertion that the displayed preimages themselves obey Heisenberg relations is added.
